name: Lesotho (1987–2006)
description: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist into a white upper hoist part and a green lower fly part by a blue band, with a brown Basotho shield, knobkerrie and crossed spears in the white.
history: Flag designed by Sergeant Retšelisitsoe Matete and adopted on 20 January 1987, after the military coup of 1986 had ousted the Basotho National Party; the traditional shield and weapons replaced the party colours. It was replaced on the fortieth anniversary of independence, 4 October 2006, by the present flag with a black mokorotlo.

features.role: Basotho shield with knobkerrie and crossed spears
